scheme_name: Grant of House Construction Subsidy to Scheduled Caste People
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a native or permanent resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry
Applicant must not already possess a house
For Scheduled Caste applicants: must have a house site of at least 450 sq.ft and annual income not exceeding ₹200,000
For Other Economically Backward Class applicants: must have a house site granted by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Department and annual income not exceeding ₹24,000
benefits_summary: Provides a construction subsidy of up to ₹4,00,000 in three installments and additional building materials worth ₹1,00,000.
